Correct and Impute Daily Feed Intake (ADFI)

Source: R/calc_adfi.R
calc_adfi.Rd

Correct daily feed intake for feeder errors with a linear mixed model, impute missing days and compute average daily feed intake (ADFI) over the ADG stage.

calc_adfi(visits, adg, qc = adg$settings, verbose = 1, cores = 1)

Arguments

visits

Visit table from prep_visits(), or already flagged by flag_feed_errors().

adg

Result of calc_adg().

qc

QC settings; by default the ones used for adg. Used here: the feeder error thresholds, dfi_correct, dfi_range, dfi_quantile, impute_method, long_gap_days, loess_span.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

cores

Number of CPU cores for the per-pig computations. Default 1.

Value

An object of class ppt_adfi (a list):

  • per_pig: adfi (g/d over the stage), adfi_raw (mean recorded intake of the recorded stage days), adfi_error_free, n_stage_days, n_observed, n_corrected, n_interpolated, n_extrapolated, n_missing, n_extrap_start / n_extrap_end (consecutive extrapolated days at the start / end of the stage), coverage (share of stage days with a recorded or corrected value), adg_type;

  • daily: one row per pig and day: bw (kg), in_stage, n_visits, n_error_visits, dfi_raw, dfi_error_free, dfi_corrected, dfi (final value, g) and state;

  • model: fixed-effect estimates of the correction model;

  • removed, settings.

References

Jiao, S., Maltecca, C., Gray, K. A., & Cassady, J. P. (2014). Feed intake, average daily gain, feed efficiency, and real-time ultrasound traits in Duroc pigs: I. Journal of Animal Science, 92, 2377-2386.

See also

flag_feed_errors(), calc_adg().

Examples

visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
w <- clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0)
adg <- calc_adg(w, verbose = 0)
adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg)
#> 
#> ── Flagging feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005) ──────────────────────────────────

#> • Extrapolated (elrp): 31
